newsitem.title: UK: LCE sugar futures end steadier nearby.
newsitem.headline: LCE sugar futures end steadier nearby.

text.p: White sugar futures remained steadier during Tuesday evening LCE trading, reflecting advances on October ahead of the position's expiry later this week.
Traders said the gains were prompted by some buying of the Oct/Dec switch, which reflected covering of the front month. A steadier trend in New York was also supportive.
Oct closed at $349.00, up $0.90 a tonne from Monday, with LCE turnover totalling 4,094 lots.
Looking ahead, traders said ample supplies could keep a lid on the market in the longer term.

This was highlighted by International Sugar Organization (ISO) executive-director Peter Baron at the start of an Asian sugar conference in New Delhi when he said that surplus world sugar supplies could push down prices in the coming months.
